title: AWS Glue Job DPU-Hour Cost Anomaly
dataSources: AWS Glue job runs (`aws:glue:jobrun`), crawler events (`aws:cloudwatch`), and CloudTrail Glue API calls (`aws:cloudtrail`).
app: AWS Glue job run and crawler events via CloudWatch/CloudTrail to the Splunk Add-on for AWS; Glue API `GetJobRuns` via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=aws:glue:jobrun
| eval dpu_hours=(max_capacity*execution_time)/3600
| timechart span=1d sum(dpu_hours) as dpu_hours by job_name
| untable _time job_name dpu_hours
| eventstats avg(dpu_hours) as avg_dpu, stdev(dpu_hours) as sd_dpu by job_name
| where dpu_hours>avg_dpu+3*sd_dpu
description: Estimates DPU-hour consumption per Glue job from capacity and execution time and flags days that spike above baseline, the main driver of Glue spend.
value: Runaway Glue jobs (data skew, bad joins) inflate DPU-hours; per-job anomaly detection catches cost overruns before the monthly bill lands.
implementation: Ingest Glue job runs with max_capacity and execution_time; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma DPU-hour spikes.
visualization: Timechart of DPU-hours per job, anomaly table, cost estimate.
grandmaExplanation: We estimate what each cloud data job costs to run and flag surprise spikes so the bill holds no surprises.
